name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-08-29, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.76 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
